artifact:
Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the system to log onset and reset of low pressure alarm
  And to trigger a low pressure alarm with a high priority
  And to automatically reset the alarm upon the first breath with inspiration pressure above the threshold
  And to compute a "pressure high" alarm that becomes active when pressure goes above a specified threshold for 3+ consecutive breaths
  And to display the "pressure high" alarm until cancelled even if inactive
  And to emit a sound while the "pressure high" alarm is active
  And to support an alarm state where the alarm is visible but not audible
  And to have the PIP too high alarm with high priority
  And to have the default value for the "PIP too high" alarm as the commanded PIP value + 5cm H2O

  Scenario: Log onset and reset of low pressure alarm
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the inspiratory pressure falls below the threshold
    Then the low pressure alarm is logged
    And the alarm is displayed with high priority
    And the alarm is automatically reset upon the first breath with inspiration pressure above the threshold

  Scenario: Trigger low pressure alarm
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the inspiratory pressure falls below the threshold
    Then the low pressure alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: Compute "pressure high" alarm
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the pressure goes above the specified threshold for 3+ consecutive breaths
    Then the "pressure high" alarm is computed and displayed
    And the alarm is active

  Scenario: Display "pressure high" alarm
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the "pressure high" alarm is active
    Then the alarm is displayed until cancelled even if inactive

  Scenario: Emit sound while "pressure high" alarm is active
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the "pressure high" alarm is active
    Then a sound is emitted

  Scenario: Support alarm state where alarm is visible but not audible
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the alarm is set to be visible but not audible
    Then the alarm is displayed but no sound is emitted

  Scenario: PIP too high alarm
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the PIP value exceeds the threshold
    Then the PIP too high alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: Default value for PIP too high alarm
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the PIP value is set to a value
    Then the default value for the "PIP too high" alarm is the commanded PIP value + 5cm H2O

  Scenario Outline: Negative/edge/boundary values
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the inspiratory pressure falls below the threshold <threshold>
    Then the low pressure alarm is triggered with high priority
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 0         |
      | 10        |
      | 20        |
      | -1        |
      | 100       |

  Scenario Outline: Negative/edge/boundary values
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the pressure goes above the specified threshold for <consecutive breaths> consecutive breaths
    Then the "pressure high" alarm is computed and displayed
    Examples:
      | consecutive breaths |
      | 0                   |
      | 1                   |
      | 2                   |
      | 3                   |
      | 4                   |

  Scenario Outline: Negative/edge/boundary values
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the PIP value exceeds the threshold <threshold>
    Then the PIP too high alarm is triggered with high priority
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 0         |
      | 10        |
      | 20        |
      | -1        |
      | 100       |
